title: Article 131 — Original jurisdiction of the Supreme Court

content.overview: Article 131 confers on the Supreme Court exclusive original jurisdiction in any dispute (a) between the Government of India and one or more States; or (b) between the Government of India and any State or States on one side and one or more other States on the other; or (c) between two or more States — if and insofar as the dispute involves any question (whether of law or fact) on which the existence or extent of a legal right depends. Provisos exclude certain disputes arising out of pre-Constitution treaties/agreements and disputes under certain treaty terms that provide for other adjudication.
content.glance: SC exclusive original jurisdiction: Union v. State(s); Union + State(s) v. other State(s); State v. State — where legal right is in issue. Treaty/agreement exclusions apply.
content.study:
Article 131 original jurisdiction is exclusive and limited to inter-governmental disputes involving a legal right. It does not extend to disputes between private parties, or between the Union/State and a private party. Provisos carve out certain treaty and agreement-based disputes.

Examination: three dispute categories; legal-right requirement; exclusive; treaty provisos; contrast with advisory jurisdiction (Art 143) and appellate jurisdiction (Arts 132–134, 136).

sections.heading: Scope

questionsAndAnswers.question: What is the original jurisdiction of the Supreme Court under Article 131?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 131, the Supreme Court has exclusive original jurisdiction in any dispute between the Government of India and one or more States; or between the Government of India and any State or States on one side and one or more other States on the other; or between two or more States — if and insofar as the dispute involves any question (whether of law or fact) on which the existence or extent of a legal right depends. Certain disputes arising from pre-Constitution treaties or agreements are excluded by proviso.

examTips: Union–State / inter-State disputes involving legal rights; exclusive; treaty exclusions.

keyTakeaways: Art 131: exclusive original jurisdiction in Union–State and inter-State legal disputes.
